name: When should I choose appliances for a custom cabinet project?

mainEntity.name: When should I choose appliances for a custom cabinet project?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Start appliance planning before cabinet fabrication because appliance dimensions, ventilation, door swings, filler requirements, and utility locations affect cabinet openings. Do not rely only on a model number; use the manufacturer’s installation specifications.

Context: A replacement appliance can require different clearances or electrical, plumbing, gas, or ventilation work. Elite Remodeling & Design’s broader remodeling process can coordinate these decisions with cabinet layouts and construction.

Key factors:
- Actual width, depth, height, and required clearances
- Panel-ready versus freestanding appliances
- Hood, refrigerator, and dishwasher door swings
- Outlet, water, gas, and duct locations

Practical guidance: Provide appliance specification sheets before final measurements. Confirm who verifies openings and who is responsible if a selected appliance changes after approval.

Early coordination prevents expensive cabinet modifications later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose or shortlist appliances before cabinet fabrication. Their exact dimensions, clearances, panels, door swings, and utility requirements determine cabinet openings and may affect electrical, plumbing, gas, or ventilation work.
